heading: Brand Kit.
intro: The AutoGlow brand identity. A collection of our visual and linguistic language, crafted to communicate luxury, precision, and protection.
logoBody: The AutoGlow primary logo is bold, clean, and modern. It must always have proper contrast and enough breathing room (clear space) when placed on any background.

principles.body: Every action is calculated. We don't just clean; we restore and enhance at a microscopic level.
principles.title: Precision

principles.body: Our aesthetics and service mirror the high-end automotive masterpieces we protect.
principles.title: Luxury

principles.body: We build for longevity. Our coatings and films are engineered to preserve perfection.
principles.title: Endurance

typography.name: Space Grotesk
typography.usage: Used for primary headlines and massive visual impact. Communicates modern luxury and edge.

typography.name: Inter Regular
typography.sample: We believe in protection that speaks for itself. The gloss should be deep, the surface flawless, and the application absolutely invisible.
typography.usage: Used for all body copy and descriptions for high legibility.

typography.name: JetBrains Mono
typography.usage: Used for technical details, coordinates, tags, and utilitarian UI text.

voice.body: We know we provide the best service, but we let our work do the talking. We use definitive language—avoiding words like "maybe", "trying to", or "hopefully".
voice.dontExample: We try our best to protect your car.
voice.title: Confident, Never Arrogant

voice.body: We respect automotive enthusiasm. We discuss microns, hydrophobic properties, and 9H hardness, but always tie it back to the real-world benefit for the owner.
voice.doExample: Our 9H ceramic matrix cross-links with the clear coat to prevent micro-marring.
voice.dontExample: It makes it shiny and hard.
voice.title: Technical, Yet Accessible
